description: List the user's Gmail drafts. Returns draft IDs, subjects, recipients, and preview snippets. Use this tool to: - Check what drafts the user has pending - Find a specific draft to update or send - Get draft IDs for use with gmail_send_draft Results include draft_id (needed for sending), subject, recipients, and a snippet preview.

max_results.description: Maximum number of drafts to return (default 10, max 50)
